sal.basis: Reference market. Saudi pay is quoted per month as a package (basic + housing + transport). v5 sets Noura at 26,000 SAR/month in Riyadh with a market band of 34,000-41,000 for her role and 38-45k for Senior Financial Analyst; f = 1 by definition. Aggregators (ZenHR 2025: Financial Analyst median 15k, Finance Manager median 25k, max 40k) sit lower, so the v5 band reads as the upper end: total package for an 8-year Saudi at a large Riyadh employer (banks, PIF companies, Aramco). See SA.sources.md.

rule.en: We skip roles open to Saudi nationals only, and if you need a new visa, roles that can't sponsor one.
rule.ar: نتخطّى الوظائف المخصّصة للسعوديين فقط، وإذا تحتاج تأشيرة جديدة نتخطّى الوظائف اللي ما تقدر تكفلك.
rule.fr: Nous écartons les postes réservés aux ressortissants saoudiens et, si vous avez besoin d'un nouveau visa, ceux qui ne peuvent pas vous parrainer.

desc.en: Under Nitaqat, private employers must keep a set share of Saudi staff. Accounting roles have their own quota at firms with five or more accountants: 40% Saudi from October 2025, rising each year to 70% by 2028. Saudi and GCC nationals count toward it.
desc.ar: بموجب نطاقات، لازم تحافظ منشآت القطاع الخاص على نسبة محددة من الموظفين السعوديين. ومهن المحاسبة لها نسبة خاصة في المنشآت اللي فيها 5 محاسبين أو أكثر: 40% سعوديين من أكتوبر 2025، وترتفع كل سنة إلى 70% بحلول 2028. والمواطن السعودي والخليجي يُحسب ضمنها.
desc.fr: Avec Nitaqat, les employeurs privés doivent maintenir une part fixe de salariés saoudiens. Les métiers de la comptabilité ont leur propre quota dans les entreprises comptant au moins cinq comptables : 40 % de Saoudiens depuis octobre 2025, puis une hausse chaque année jusqu'à 70 % en 2028. Les ressortissants saoudiens et du CCG sont pris en compte.

sensitive.notes: Photo: common on Saudi CVs and some employers ask for one, so it is optional (v5: 'Some employers in Saudi ask for one') and only sent where a form asks. Gender: Saudi forms routinely require it (and some roles are gender-specific), v5 asks it. Nationality: drives Saudization counting, Iqama/visa status and Jadarat eligibility, v5 asks it. DOB and marital status often appear on Gulf CVs and on some portals but are not needed for matching; v5 does not collect them, so we leave them off (conservative, PDPL data-minimisation).

bio.en: Financial Analyst with 8 years in Riyadh. I lead IFRS reporting and budgeting on SAP across business units and own the monthly close for a 40-person function. I built the rolling forecasts and variance analysis that cut our reporting time by a third. I am looking for a Senior Financial Analyst or FP&A role in Riyadh, Jeddah, or remote.
bio.ar: محللة مالية بخبرة 8 سنوات في الرياض. أقود تقارير IFRS والموازنة على SAP عبر وحدات الأعمال، وأملك الإقفال الشهري لإدارة من 40 موظفاً. بنيت التوقعات المتحركة وتحليل الانحرافات التي قلّصت وقت التقارير بالثلث. أبحث عن وظيفة محلل مالي أول أو تخطيط وتحليل مالي في الرياض أو جدة أو عن بُعد.
bio.fr: Analyste financière avec 8 ans d'expérience à Riyad. Je pilote le reporting IFRS et le budget sur SAP pour plusieurs business units, et je suis responsable de la clôture mensuelle d'une fonction de 40 personnes. J'ai mis en place les prévisions glissantes et l'analyse des écarts qui ont réduit d'un tiers notre délai de reporting. Je recherche un poste d'analyste financière senior ou en FP&A à Riyad, à Djeddah ou en télétravail.

culture.notes: Work week Sunday to Thursday (Friday-Saturday weekend since 2013); interviews and deadlines in copy should use Sun-Thu days (v5 does). Salaries are quoted per month, as a package: basic plus housing and transport allowances; offers often show basic and total separately. Government pays on the 27th of the Gregorian month; private employers usually pay around month end. Notice: the amended Labour Law (in force February 2025) sets 30 days for an employee ending an indefinite contract and 60 days for the employer; many professional contracts still state 60 days, and v5 has Noura on 60 days. Non-Saudis on indefinite contracts are treated as on renewable one-year fixed terms; an expat moving via Qiwa after a year of service can face a 90-day notice unless the employer shortens it. CVs: 1-2 pages, English (an Arabic version helps for semi-government roles), with a personal block (nationality, Iqama or visa status, sometimes photo and date of birth). Cover letters are rarely required; portals ask short motivation and screening questions instead (e.g. SOCPA membership, SAMA experience, relocation). Employers verify history against GOSI and ask for National ID or Iqama, degree and certificates at offer stage. Jadarat is the national platform for Saudi job seekers and the main route into government and semi-government roles.
